body:
I was all out of weed and I've been thinking about just trying catnip, just to see what happens, you know? So I stole some of my cats bud and loaded it in my pipe.
There really is no difference between the taste and smell of that and weed. The effects came almost immediately. The light in the room got brighter, then dimmer. A little euphoria was there, and a little closed eye visuals. This lasted for three hours, then I came down.
Was it worth it? Yes, and...no. Its a good emergency high, you know? When I'm out of weed, this is good just to have.
